当你的应用需要解析和验证数字证书时使用证书算法库能力
典型场景包括对接收的服务端证书进行解析获取基本字段或扩展字段用于显示或校验，使用CA证书链和CRL校验证书的合法性，以及网络双向认证、服务器证书校验等安全场景
当你的应用需要管理系统级证书时使用证书管理能力
典型场景包括安装应用证书凭据用于网络双向认证场景下的数据签名，安装用户CA证书用于校验对端身份，以及通过对话框界面进行证书的查看、安装和删除操作
解析服务器返回的PEM或DER证书并读取主题、颁发者和有效期 / Parse PEM or DER certificates from a server and read subject, issuer, and validity period
加载客户端证书和私钥用于双向TLS身份认证 / Load client certificates and private keys for mutual TLS authentication
导入P12或PKCS#12证书包并提取身份凭据 / Import a P12 or PKCS#12 bundle and extract identity credentials
校验远端服务证书是否被系统或自定义根证书信任 / Verify whether a remote service certificate is trusted by system or custom root CAs
读取证书扩展字段如SubjectAltName、KeyUsage和BasicConstraints / Read certificate extensions such as SubjectAltName, KeyUsage, and BasicConstraints
检查证书是否过期并在到期前提示更新 / Check whether a certificate is expired and prompt renewal before expiry
用自定义TrustAnchor校验私有CA签发的证书链 / Validate a certificate chain issued by a private CA with custom TrustAnchors
生成并验证CRL数据以拦截已吊销设备证书 / Generate and verify CRL data to block revoked device certificates
在线查询OCSP或吊销状态确认设备证书是否失效 / Query OCSP or revocation status online to confirm a device certificate is no longer valid
管理应用安装的证书凭据并在不用时安全删除 / Manage app-installed certificate credentials and securely delete them when no longer needed
对消息或文件做CMS签名并验证签名来源 / Create CMS signatures for messages or files and verify the signer
用CMS封装证书实现数据加密传输与解密 / Encrypt and decrypt data with CMS enveloping and certificates
do_not_use_when: 需求是华为账号登录、一键获取手机号、静默登录，或读取头像昵称、收货地址、发票抬头等账号资料；应改用 account-kit / The requirement is Huawei account sign-in, one-tap phone number retrieval, silent sign-in, or fetching profile data such as avatar, nickname, shipping address, or invoice title; use account-kit instead
preconditions: 工程已启用 Device Certificate Kit 对应SDK能力并正确引入相关接口模块 / The project has enabled the Device Certificate Kit SDK capability and correctly imported the relevant API modules

若涉及系统级证书管理或证书管理对话框，应用已在 module.json5 中声明所需权限并满足系统限制 / If system-level certificate management or certificate-management dialogs are involved, the app has declared required permissions in module.json5 and meets system restrictions
若涉及安装、删除或使用系统证书/凭据，用户或系统已授予相应操作许可 / If installing, deleting, or using system certificates/credentials is involved, the user or system has granted the required authorization
若涉及在线下载中间CA证书或在线校验吊销状态，设备网络可用且目标服务可访问 / If online intermediate-CA download or online revocation checking is involved, network connectivity is available and the target services are reachable
inputs: X509证书字节流、PEM/DER文本或证书对象 / X509 certificate bytes, PEM/DER text, or certificate object
证书链、信任锚或CA证书集合 / Certificate chain, trust anchors, or CA certificate set
CRL数据、CMS签名/封装数据或PKCS12文件内容 / CRL data, CMS signed/enveloped data, or PKCS12 file content
应用证书凭据别名、证书标识或管理操作参数 / App credential alias, certificate identifier, or management operation parameters
outputs: X509证书对象（X509Cert） / X.509 certificate object (X509Cert)
X509证书编码数据（DER/PEM字节数据） / Encoded X.509 certificate data (DER/PEM bytes)
证书字段解析结果（颁发者、使用者、序列号、有效期、公钥、签名算法等） / Parsed certificate field values (issuer, subject, serial number, validity period, public key, signature algorithm, etc.)
证书扩展信息对象（CertExtension） / Certificate extension object (CertExtension)
证书扩展OID列表和扩展项内容 / Certificate extension OID list and extension entry values
CA证书判断结果 / CA certificate determination result
X509证书吊销列表对象（X509Crl） / X.509 certificate revocation list object (X509Crl)
CRL编码数据和吊销条目解析结果 / Encoded CRL data and parsed revoked-certificate entries
证书吊销状态校验结果 / Certificate revocation status validation result
证书集合对象和按条件查询得到的证书列表 / Certificate collection object and condition-matched certificate list
CRL集合对象和按条件查询得到的CRL列表 / CRL collection object and condition-matched CRL list
证书链对象（X509CertChain） / X.509 certificate chain object (X509CertChain)
证书链中的证书列表 / Certificate list contained in a certificate chain
证书链校验器对象（CertChainValidator） / Certificate chain validator object (CertChainValidator)
证书链合法性校验结果 / Certificate chain validity validation result
信任锚对象数组（TrustAnchor[]） / Trust anchor object array (TrustAnchor[])
在线吊销校验结果（CRL/终端实体证书状态） / Online revocation validation result (CRL/end-entity certificate status)
自动下载的中间CA证书 / Automatically downloaded intermediate CA certificates
已安装的应用证书凭据标识或别名 / Installed application certificate credential identifier or alias
应用证书凭据对象或凭据详情 / Application certificate credential object or credential details
使用应用证书凭据生成的签名数据 / Signature data generated with an application certificate credential
用户CA证书列表 / User CA certificate list
用户CA证书详情或编码数据 / User CA certificate details or encoded data
证书管理对话框操作结果 / Certificate management dialog operation result
CMS签名数据（SignedData） / CMS signed data (SignedData)
CMS验签结果 / CMS signature verification result
CMS封装数据或加密封装数据（EnvelopedData） / CMS enveloped data or encrypted enveloped data (EnvelopedData)
CMS解封装后的明文数据 / Plaintext data after CMS de-enveloping
PKCS12密钥库文件或字节数据（.p12/.pfx） / PKCS#12 keystore file or byte data (.p12/.pfx)
PKCS12解析得到的私钥、证书和证书链 / Private key, certificate, and certificate chain parsed from PKCS#12

postconditions.statement: 已新增或修改代码以调用 Device Certificate Kit 相关API，而非仅停留在通用安全或网络接口 / Code was added or modified to call Device Certificate Kit APIs rather than only generic security or networking interfaces
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set clearly introduce or update HarmonyOS Device Certificate Kit API usage for certificate/CRL/chain/CMS/PKCS12/credential management?

postconditions.statement: 若任务是证书处理，代码已体现对证书、证书链、CRL、CMS或PKCS12至少一种对象的解析、校验、创建或管理流程 / If the task is certificate-related, the code reflects parsing, validation, creation, or management of at least one of certificate, certificate chain, CRL, CMS, or PKCS12 objects
postconditions.judge_prompt: By inspecting the edits, is there a concrete flow that handles at least one certificate-related object such as an X509 certificate, chain, CRL, CMS payload, or PKCS12 keystore?

postconditions.statement: 若涉及系统级证书管理，工程配置已同步补充必要权限或调用证书管理对话框/管理接口 / If system-level certificate management is involved, the project configuration was updated with necessary permissions or the certificate-management dialog/management APIs were invoked
postconditions.judge_prompt: If the task includes installing, deleting, or using system/app credentials or CA certificates, do the edits also include the required permission/configuration changes or management API/dialog usage?
